::: {#sol-undo-noise}

Solve $\vx_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t} \, \vx_0 + \sqrt{1 - \bar\alpha_t} \, \est{\vnoise}$ for $\vx_0$:

$$
\est{\vx}_0 = \frac{\vx_t - \sqrt{1 - \bar\alpha_t} \, \est{\vnoise}}{\sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}}.
$$

A network that predicts the noise well can remove it,
so predicting the noise is a way to predict the data.

:::
